title: hamelia patens var. erecta
intro: Hamelia patens var. erecta, commonly known as Firecracker Plant, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is a shrub native to Central and South America, valued for its vibrant red flowers and potential medicinal properties. The Firecracker Plant is reported to possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of Hamelia patens var. erecta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
